$comment: Shared contract for the animated water shoreline. Both the native Zig plugin and the maplibre-gl-js layer are tested against this file.

shore-width.doc: Width of the animated band, in logical pixels, from the shoreline into the water.

shore-color.doc: Shallow-water tint at the shoreline; fades out across the band.

foam-color.doc: Color of the breaking crests and the wash at the shoreline.

wave-count.doc: Number of crests across the band; 0 leaves only the wash.

wave-speed.doc: Crests per second travelling toward the shore; negative moves them out to sea and 0 freezes every animation.

wave-wobble.doc: How irregular the crests are: 0 draws smooth lines parallel to the shore, 1 breaks them into wobbling patches.

foam-length.doc: How far behind each crest its foam trails, as a fraction of the crest spacing.

wash-strength.doc: Strength of the bubbling wash right at the shoreline.
